[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Hassk''' was an extremist [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] warrior who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] moon of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He had a strong distaste for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and those who gave in to the wishes of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|If yousa tinken Gungans need to be more war like, yousa come see me and bring weapons. If yousa thinken wesa Gungans should be saddled like kaadu, then yousa come see meesa so Isa can spit on you. Ptuh!|Captain Hassk|<ref name="10HSTG" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Hassk was the commander of the [[Rorgungans]],<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> a group of extremist Gungans who violently opposed [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass's]] support of Naboo's human population during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and rejected any alliance between humans and Gungans.<ref name="CDAG">{{SonyCite|url=players/guides.vm?id=80112|text=CorSec Database A-G|int=CorSec Database A-G}}</ref> Captain Hassk believed that the Gungans of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] were weak and too afraid to stand up for their own rights.<ref name="10HSTG" />

By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Captain Hassk was leading the Gungan resistance on Rori against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] from a [[Gungan Swamp Town|camp]] established deep in the heart of the [[Lake Octir Swamp|swamps]] of Rori. It was from here that he welcomed fellow Gungans to seek refuge from the oppression of Imperials. In order to strike out against the Empire, Hassk also intended to recruit Gungans from Naboo to support the Rorian Gungans in their fight. He would later strike from the moon against the forces controlling the [[Naboo system/Legends|Naboo system]] in an attempt to free Naboo and Rori.<ref name="10HSTG" /> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Ori (Gungan)|Ori]] and [[Heb Nee]] served under him.<ref name="SWG:RGST" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Hassk appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RGST" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Captain Hassk was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 1 Notes: 13 August 03|Publish 1]]" update, released on [[August 3]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60888|text=Publish 1: Nightsisters Cave}}</ref>
